title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 3
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q021_above_the_law
elements.title: When someone acts as if ordinary rules cannot be enforced against them, they act as if they are ___.

elements.name: q022_major_player
elements.title: With almost half the market, the company is a ___ in the industry.

elements.name: q023_point
elements.title: “What's the ___ of buying a second ticket if you're going alone?”

elements.name: q024_muted
elements.title: Her announcement received a ___ response, with only a few polite claps.

elements.name: q025_alarming
elements.title: The inspector found an ___ crack in a main support beam and closed the building immediately.

elements.name: q026_spell_trouble
elements.title: A sudden fall in income could ___ for the shop if it can no longer pay its rent.

elements.name: q027_whodunnit
elements.title: The novel is a ___ in which readers try to guess who stole the painting.

elements.name: q028_make_landfall
elements.title: The storm is expected to ___ on the coast tomorrow morning.

elements.name: q029_fuel
elements.title: The generator uses diesel to ___ its engine.

elements.name: q030_the_eye_of_the_storm
elements.title: At the very centre of the storm, known as the ___, conditions were briefly calm.
